clock_note: MT5 returns server-clock timestamps. Every time is written twice: time_server is the broker wall clock, time_utc is the same instant corrected by server_offset_seconds. FTMO's trading day boundary is CE(S)T midnight, not either of these.
cadence_note: The dashboard's published view is a snapshot of this file. It is only fresh while a producer is running against the terminal.

history.note: Deals, not trades: the entry and exit deals of one position are paired here by position_id. A trade that closed before this window is not in the list, and a position with an entry deal and no exit deal inside it is still open, so it appears in positions instead.
